title: Hot Stamping Foil for Textured Specialty Paper

seo.title: Hot Stamping Foil for Textured Specialty Paper

content:
Textured specialty paper gives packaging a premium and tactile look, but it also makes foil stamping more difficult than smooth paper.

## Why Texture Matters

A textured surface is uneven. The foil may transfer well on raised areas but appear incomplete in lower areas. This can create broken lines, missing spots or uneven shine.

## How to Choose

Use a foil grade with good coverage and stable transfer. Do not approve the foil on flat paper only. Always test the exact specialty paper used in production.

Avoid extremely thin lines and very small reverse text on deep texture. Larger lettering and simpler logos usually give a more stable result.

## Testing Advice

Test small text, thin lines, the final logo and one solid area. If the missing spots follow the paper texture, the paper surface is the main factor.

## FAQ

### Can textured paper be foil stamped?

Yes, but real-material testing is necessary.

### What is the biggest risk?

The biggest risk is incomplete transfer in low areas of the texture.
